snippet.title: Dungeon Sweeper Trailer
snippet.description:
Dungeon Sweeper - Minesweeper meets roguelike. Out November 2026 on Steam.

Deduce where the monsters hide, then decide which ones are worth fighting. Battles resolve on their own based on your gear, so the real challenge is reading the board and knowing when to walk away. Find better loot, grow stronger between floors and take on three acts, each with a boss at the end.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282820/Dungeon_Sweeper/
🆓 Free demo available on the Steam page

#DungeonSweeper #Roguelike #Minesweeper #IndieGame #PixelArt
